title: Structure nodes stay on their own PDF only
description:
Map Builder was showing structure nodes from other PDFs on the open map. Nodes are stored in one list (correct), but the renderer was treating every workspace PDF as “on this board,” and DOM refresh re-painted every node with no filter.

Markers now only appear when their storageKey matches the currently open PDF pages. Switching maps no longer pulls in nodes from other files.

Who is affected: PipeSync Map Building on pipeshare.live (BASE). SaaS unchanged until cPanel apply.

Hard-refresh PipeSync and reopen the map — you should only see nodes created on that PDF.
changeLog: Scope structure-node display to the open PDF’s storageKeys only.
Stop unioning all map workspaces when painting structure markers.
Filter DOM refresh so foreign PDF nodes are not re-appended.
